about: Models timeline: each notable model linked to the papers that describe it and the topics that explain its parts. Add new models here as they come out (see ../UPDATING.md). Checked by check-curriculum.mjs.

models.name: LeNet-5
models.whatsNew: Convolutions and pooling trained end to end by backprop; read cheques.

models.name: AlexNet
models.whatsNew: A deep CNN on GPUs with ReLU and dropout won ImageNet by a wide margin.

models.name: word2vec
models.whatsNew: Word meanings as vectors learned from context.

models.name: GAN
models.whatsNew: A generator and a discriminator trained against each other.

models.name: ResNet
models.whatsNew: Skip connections let networks go 100+ layers deep.

models.name: AlphaGo
models.whatsNew: Tree search guided by policy and value networks beat a Go champion.

models.name: Transformer
models.whatsNew: Attention only, no recurrence: the base of every modern LLM.

models.name: BERT
models.whatsNew: Pre-train by filling in masked words, then fine-tune for any task.

models.name: GPT-2
models.whatsNew: A bigger decoder-only model doing tasks it was never trained for.

models.name: GPT-3
models.whatsNew: 175B parameters; learns new tasks from examples in the prompt.

models.name: CLIP
models.whatsNew: Images and text in one embedding space, from 400M image–text pairs.

models.name: InstructGPT
models.whatsNew: RLHF makes a model follow instructions; the method behind ChatGPT.

models.name: Latent diffusion (Stable Diffusion)
models.whatsNew: Diffusion in a compressed latent space, conditioned on text.

models.name: Chinchilla
models.whatsNew: Train on many more tokens for the same compute.

models.name: LLaMA and Llama 2
models.whatsNew: Open weights with RoPE, SwiGLU and RMSNorm; Llama 2 adds chat tuning.

models.name: GPT-4
models.published: technical report (architecture and training not disclosed)
models.whatsNew: Multimodal; the report gives results and predictable scaling, not the architecture.

models.name: Mistral 7B
models.whatsNew: Grouped-query and sliding-window attention in a small strong model.

models.name: Mamba
models.whatsNew: Selective state spaces: linear-time sequence modelling.

models.name: Llama 3
models.whatsNew: A detailed public account of training a frontier-scale model: data, 4D parallelism, post-training.

models.name: DeepSeek-V3
models.whatsNew: A large mixture-of-experts model trained with FP8 and multi-token prediction.

models.name: DeepSeek-R1
models.whatsNew: Reasoning learned with reinforcement learning on checkable answers (GRPO).

models.name: Claude models
models.published: not published (architecture, data and training recipe); research on methods is published
models.whatsNew: Anthropic has published its alignment methods (constitutional AI, RLHF) and interpretability work on Claude 3 Sonnet, not how its models are built. Lessons say exactly this.
